name: Steel Dynamics, Inc.
base_source: agent_supplied_ttm_override: TTM OE through Q2 2026 from EDGAR 10-Q YTD — OCF FY25 $1,449.5M - H1'25 $454.2M + H1'26 $576.3M = $1,571.6M; capex FY25 $948.0M - H1'25 $593.8M + H1'26 $261.8M = $616.0M; SBC FY25 $69.0M - H1'25 $31.1M + H1'26 $31.6M = $69.5M; TTM OE $886.1M / 145.0M diluted shares (H1 2026) = $6.11/share. Engine normalized median $2.91 rejected: it equals the latest FY by arithmetic (median of 2023 $10.75, 2024 -$0.58, 2025 $2.91) and inherits the 2023-25 growth-capex distortion (Sinton + Aluminum Dynamics); TTM uses post-construction capex (2026 guided ~$600M).
moat_justification: EAF mini-mill structural cost advantage (variable scrap-based costs, lower capex/ton, 90% utilization vs ~81% industry), OmniSource vertical integration into scrap, diversified value-added/fabrication mix, best-in-class 13% 3-yr after-tax ROIC and a decade of buybacks — against commodity price-taking on steel and scrap spreads, the same EAF model at larger scale at Nucor, no switching costs or pricing power (net income fell 69% from 2022 to 2025), current spreads partly underwritten by trade policy, and an unproven, loss-making aluminum platform.
fragility_flags: STALE_FY: latest fiscal year ended 9 months ago — check TTM/quarterly OE and consider --base-oe-ps override
WIDE_SCENARIO_SPREAD: super-bull IV is 4.3x super-bear IV — uncertainty is huge; confidence should not be high
HIGH_NET_DEBT: net debt is 3.8x normalized OE — levered OE can vanish fast; stress the bear cases
BUYBACK_TAILWIND: share count shrinking 7.0%/yr — already credited via the growth adjustment
BASIS_BREAK_SUSPECT: a >60% revenue jump/drop in the last 5 yrs — check for divestitures, big M&A, or restatements before trusting any CAGR
OE_VOLATILE: OE/share range over the last 5 yrs spans >3x — normalized base helps but the business is cyclical; widen bear weight
one_liner: Best-in-class EAF steelmaker with a real cost advantage but no pricing power, moat 5/10 — at $240.63 (39.4x TTM owner's earnings of $6.11/share, into a guided record quarter) it yields a 5.3% weighted IRR with IV@15% of $52.57; it clears the 15% hurdle only at ~$53 (~$42 with a margin of safety), and even the super-bull case ($105.04) stays below half today's price.
